source_request: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create a randomized, complex, reference-informed photographic test of a living necromancer causally consulting a specific dead person, so the concept is visible through action and response rather than costume alone.
subject: An unmistakably adult woman as a living necromancer and the apparition of one named dead astronomer
setting: A rain-flooded abandoned observatory at midnight
event: She deliberately questions the dead astronomer through a portrait medallion and receives a visible answer on a brass star chart
visual_priorities: Reference-informed adult facial appearance with coherent photorealistic reflections
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic cinematic editorial photograph in a rain-flooded abandoned observatory at midnight. An unmistakably adult woman serves as the living operator. Her visible facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural styling follow the reference portrait. A living necromancer deliberately questions a specific dead astronomer by touching the astronomer's portrait medallion inside an abstract ring of smooth dark stones. A translucent apparition matching the medallion portrait forms above it. The apparition points toward one moving star while the wet brass chart needle has visibly shifted in response. Frame the operator, memorial anchor, apparition, and changed instrument together in a wide three-quarter view, with practical moonlight through the dome and physically coherent floor reflections.
